answer: The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. What survives to the onyx is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
